basic_details.job_title: AIIMS Bhubaneswar Project Research Scientist I Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online
basic_details.short_information: The Department of Biochemistry at All India Institute of Medical Sciences (AIIMS), Bhubaneswar is filling one Project Research Scientist-I (Medical) post on a purely temporary contractual basis under the ICMR project 'Addressing tuberculosis related undernutrition and antitubercular treatment response via gut microbiota modulation'. The pay is Rs. 67000/-+ HRA, as admissible, for only 12 months. The essential qualification is MBBS/MD and the maximum age is 35 years. age_limit.details: The maximum age limit is 35 years. The cut-off date for age is the date of the Walk-In-Interview/Video Conferencing, that is, the date of the interview. Age relaxation is admissible for SC/ST/OBC/PWD candidates as per government rules.

qualification.details: Essential qualification: MBBS/MD. Desirable: MBBS/MD with research experience in clinical projects, molecular biology research and analysis. Qualification and experience should be in the relevant discipline/field and from an institution of repute. Experience should have been gained after acquiring the minimum essential qualification.

how_to_apply: Fill the Application Form in the prescribed format only. The form is given on pages 4 to 7 of the notice.

Give the details the form asks for: name, sex, category, marital status, father's/spouse name, date of birth, age, addresses, nationality, educational qualification, current activities, experience, two referees and any other information, with the signed declaration.
Enclose self-attested photocopies of degree/diploma certificates and mark sheets, as the form states.
Type "Application for the post or Project Research Scientist-I (Medical)" in the subject line, as printed in the notice.
Make sure the application reaches by 5:00 PM on or before 13 November 2026.

There is no need to send a hard copy of the application form or documents at this stage. Late and incomplete applications, or applications not in the prescribed format, will not be considered. A separate application should be submitted for each post.
important_instructions: The engagement can be terminated at any time by one month's notice on either side. It can also be terminated forthwith, or before the notice period expires, by paying a sum equal to one month's contractual amount. A candidate will not be permitted to surrender one month's contractual amount in lieu of the unexpired notice period, and must serve the full period of notice. A contract appointee has no claim on a regular post in the institute, the funding agency or any Department of Government of India. An undertaking to that effect must be submitted at the time of joining. Submission of wrong or false information disqualifies the candidature at any stage. Canvassing in any form is a disqualification. AIIMS, BBSR reserves the right to cancel or modify the recruitment process and to consider or reject any application. The decision of the Director is final and binding. Any corrigendum, addendum or further information will be published on the AIIMS website only.

content_sections.text: The official notification does not specify the application fee.

rows.details: All India Institute of Medical Sciences, Bhubaneswar
Addressing tuberculosis related undernutrition and antitubercular treatment response via gut microbiota modulation

content_sections.heading: About the Project
content_sections.text: AIIMS Bhubaneswar is described on its letterhead as a statutory body under the aegis of the Ministry of H & F.W., Government of India, at Sijua, Post: Dumuduma, Bhubaneswar-751019. The post is sanctioned under an ICMR project in the Department of Biochemistry, led by Dr. Balamurugan Ramadass, Additional Professor. The notice is dated 29 October 2026 (E-File No. BIOCHM-17/1/2024-BIOCHEM DEPT).

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Essential qualification: MBBS/MD. Desirable: MBBS/MD with research experience in clinical projects, molecular biology research and analysis. Qualification and experience should be in the relevant discipline/field and from an institution of repute. Experience should have been gained after acquiring the minimum essential qualification. The maximum age limit is 35 years. The cut-off date for age is the date of the Walk-In-Interview/Video Conferencing, that is, the date of the interview. Age relaxation is admissible for SC/ST/OBC/PWD candidates as per government rules. Persons already in regular time scale service under any Government Department/Organisation are not eligible to apply. Mere fulfilment of the essential qualification does not guarantee selection. Candidates should read the official notification for the full eligibility conditions of the post.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The emoluments are Rs. 67000/-+ HRA, as admissible, and the tenure is only 12 months. The notice says the rates shown are as per the guidelines and the sanction. The post is purely a temporary contract appointment. The initial contract will normally be for the period specified. Further continuation or extension depends on the requirement of the project, performance evaluation and approval of the competent authority, case to case. Benefits of Provident Fund, Pension Scheme, Leave Travel Concession and Medical claim are not admissible. Leave is applicable as per Funding Agency/Institutional policy for contract staff of AIIMS, BBSR.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for AIIMS Bhubaneswar Project Research Scientist-I (Medical)
content_sections.text: Fill the Application Form in the prescribed format only. The form is given on pages 4 to 7 of the notice. Give the details the form asks for: name, sex, category, marital status, father's/spouse name, date of birth, age, addresses, nationality, educational qualification, current activities, experience, two referees and any other information, with the signed declaration. Enclose self-attested photocopies of degree/diploma certificates and mark sheets, as the form states. Email the application to [email protected] . Type "Application for the post or Project Research Scientist-I (Medical)" in the subject line, as printed in the notice. Make sure the application reaches by 5:00 PM on or before 13 November 2026. There is no need to send a hard copy of the application form or documents at this stage. Late and incomplete applications, or applications not in the prescribed format, will not be considered. A separate application should be submitted for each post.

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: The list of shortlisted candidates will be displayed on the website of AIIMS BBSR. These candidates will be called for interview/personal discussion through a Walk-In-Interview or a Video Conferencing Interview. The tentative date is 27 November 2026. The venue and reporting time are not specified in the notice. Engagement for the position will be decided by the selection committee/appointing authority. If selected, a candidate must produce the following in original for verification at the time of joining: Educational qualification certificates. Proof of date of birth. Experience certificates. One recent passport size photograph. Identity proof such as Aadhaar/PAN/Voter ID/Driving License etc. One set of self-attested photocopies of all documents. SC/ST/OBC/Disability Certificate, if applicable. Candidates who fail to bring the original certificates, or whose documents show a discrepancy, will not be allowed to join, and the position will be offered to waiting list candidates.

A contract appointee has no claim on a regular post in the institute, the funding agency or any Department of Government of India. An undertaking to that effect must be submitted at the time of joining. Submission of wrong or false information disqualifies the candidature at any stage. faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there?
faq.answer: There is 1 vacancy for Project Research Scientist-I (Medical).

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply?
faq.answer: Applications must reach [email protected] by 5:00 PM on or before 13 November 2026.

faq.question: Q3. What is the qualification required?
faq.answer: The essential qualification is MBBS/MD. MBBS/MD with research experience in clinical projects, molecular biology research and analysis is desirable.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit?
faq.answer: The maximum age is 35 years, counted on the date of the interview. SC/ST/OBC/PWD candidates get relaxation as per government rules.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary?
faq.answer: The emoluments are Rs. 67000/-+ HRA, as admissible, for a tenure of only 12 months.

faq.question: Q6. How do I apply?
faq.answer: Fill the prescribed Application Form and email it to [email protected] with the subject line given in the notice. No hard copy is needed at this stage.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process?
faq.answer: Shortlisted candidates, listed on the AIIMS BBSR website, are called for a Walk-In-Interview or Video Conferencing Interview, tentatively on 27 November 2026.

faq.question: Q8. Is this a permanent job?
faq.answer: No. The post is purely on temporary contract basis for only 12 months, and a contract appointee has no claim on a regular post.

faq.question: Q9. Is HRA paid on top of the pay?
faq.answer: The notice prints the emoluments as Rs. 67000/-+ HRA, as admissible, so HRA is shown in addition to Rs. 67000/-, to the extent admissible.

faq.question: Q10. Can a person in regular government service apply?
faq.answer: No. Persons already in regular time scale service under any Government Department/Organisation are not eligible to apply.
